items.title: F-Secure Launches Victim-First Scam Encyclopedia Covering 50+ Types of Consumer Fraud
items.summary: There are more than 50 distinct ways to scam someone online, and F-Secure's Threat Intelligence team catalogued them all in its new Scam Encyclopedia,one of the most comprehensive guides to scams and fraudavailable today. Built from decades of research, the continuously updated, living guide covers both established scams and new methods most people haven't heard of yet.
